_comment: Manifest for layout/adc-top/parasitics/run_extract_parasitics.py -- the
asserted expectations for `klt extract --parasitics` run against the two
committed adc-top blocks. This is the parasitic-extraction analogue of
layout/lvs/cells/cells.json: the runner extracts live on every run and
asserts the structured summary against these numbers, so a silent change
in what the deck extracts (a dropped device class, a parasitic table that
stopped populating) fails loudly instead of minting a green-looking record
over different geometry.
gds          source layout, relative to THIS file's directory.
gds_sha256   sha256 of that GDS, asserted so a record provably belongs
to the committed geometry (mirrors run_lvs.py's artifact
hashing). Regenerate with `run_extract_parasitics.py
--regen-manifest` after a deliberate layout change.
top          top cell to extract (the stream carries more than one).
expect.device_count / net_count / pin_count  the real (non-parasitic)
device tally, the extracted net count, and the pin count.
expect.device_counts  per-class device tally. cap_mim_2f0_m4m5_noshield
is the CDAC array's 1024 unit capacitors (both sides, all
weighted + fixed positions); nfet/pfet are the four-leg
bottom-plate switch network and its local drivers (DR-0014).
expect.parasitics.r_count / c_count  the first-order lumped RC the
--parasitics flag adds (one series R + one ground C per net
the deck's curated sheet-R/C table covers). > 0 is the whole
point of this run vs. the schematic-equivalent extraction
layout/lvs already does; asserting the exact count catches a
deck whose parasitic table silently stopped populating.
Numbers are for the DR-0014 four-leg bottom-plate topology as drawn on
main at the time this manifest was minted (adc_block back to 0.09619 mm^2
after #69, MiM stack fixed after #82/#87). They are NOT the superseded
DR-0011 224-device draw.
